description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AuthenticationException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Authentication\Exception' namespace. The class extends PHP's built-in Exception class and provides specific static methods to generate exceptions with predefined error codes and messages related to authentication errors in the OrangeHRM system. It also uses a trait for internationalization support and includes constants for different authentication error types.

classes.name: AuthenticationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling various authentication-related errors within the OrangeHRM system. It includes predefined error codes and messages, and supports internationalization features.
